description:
Make issue drafts carry the id the mutation already derived, so no issue ever exists with an empty-string id.

## Background

`Issue::draft` sets `id: String::new()` (`crates/jit/src/domain/types.rs:521-526`), and the finalizer overwrites it through `allocate` (`repository_state/mutation.rs:762`, batch path `:802`). Callers already derive issue ids before capture through `MutationContext::identifier_at` (`commands/mod.rs:2369,2869`, `commands/batch_create.rs:303`, `commands/template.rs:468,1068`). The same context also allocates gate-run ids (`commands/gate_check.rs:871`, `storage/gate_runs.rs:33`, `mutation.rs:1074`) and event ids (`mutation.rs:1214`), which keep their own types. A validated issue id cannot represent the empty sentinel.

`Issue::draft` has about 38 callers: `graph/hierarchy.rs` (9), `domain/queries.rs` (8), `visualization.rs` (6), `validation/graph.rs` (2), `validation/local.rs` (2), and one each in `output.rs`, `domain/item.rs`, `domain/types.rs`, `commands/issue.rs`, `commands/batch_create.rs`, `commands/template.rs`, `commands/template_expand.rs`, `crates/server/src/routes.rs` and the `main.rs` of the `cli_query_graph`, `fast_docs_templates`, `fast_issue` and `fast_rules` suites.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `Issue::draft` takes the issue's `IssueId` as a parameter, and no code path creates an issue whose id is empty. While `IssueId` is the staging alias for `String`, this holds by construction at every call site; the type-level guarantee arrives with the newtype switch 7abcc22d (amended with invoker approval, 2026-10-29).
- [hard] REQ-02: Issue ids are derived as `IssueId` through a dedicated issue-id accessor on the mutation context; gate-run and event allocations keep their own types.
- [hard] REQ-03: The finalizer no longer assigns issue ids, and the id recorded in the creation event equals the id the caller derived.
- [hard] REQ-04: Single, batch and template-driven creation produce the same ids as before for the same mutation seed.
- [hard] REQ-05: Test callers of `Issue::draft` take their ids from the shared canonical-id fixture.

## Notes

A separate id-less draft type and a nil-UUID placeholder were rejected: the first adds a type, the second is a protocol sentinel.
title: Issue drafts carry their pre-derived identifier
